name: web

scripts.//prebuild: The agent package is consumed as compiled output. Invoked via tsc directly rather than `npm run --workspace` so it works from this directory, which is what Vercel builds from.

//optionalDependencies: Tailwind v4 compiles CSS with native binaries. npm resolves those per-platform via optional deps, and a lockfile generated on Windows records only the Windows ones — so a Linux CI builder finds no .node file and the build dies on globals.css. Pinning the Linux binaries explicitly puts them in the lockfile. They are optional, so they are skipped on other platforms. Versions must match their parent packages exactly.
